title: Matched-duty verification of maintenance intervention and physical capability restoration

owns: acceptance-envelope owner and content digest binding
measurement-level evidence digest and calibration validity interval

paradigm.repair_assertion_is_not_restoration: A work order or technician statement records an intervention; it does not prove that a physical function was restored.
paradigm.matched_conditions: Pre- and post-repair episodes must satisfy frozen load/speed/ambient/control-mode tolerances before a restoration comparison is eligible.
paradigm.independent_measurement: Both pre-repair baseline and post-repair verification use the same currently calibrated reference measurement principle and dependency domain; that path is structurally distinct from the diagnostic path. This establishes pathway diversity, not statistical independence or source authenticity.
paradigm.per_capability_non_compensation: Required capabilities are reported separately. A pass for the repaired function cannot compensate for regression in another required function.
paradigm.causal_ceiling: Even matched pre/post evidence without concurrent changes establishes an observed association only. Causal repair-effect claims require an appropriate controlled/counterfactual design.

hard_gates: Repair record identity, component identity and source digest must be present.
Pre-repair episode must end before intervention begins.
Post-repair episode must begin after intervention completion.
Pre and post episodes must bind the same asset.
Pre episode configuration must match the declared before-configuration digest.
Post episode configuration must match the declared after-configuration digest.
Every declared matching condition must be present in both episodes and satisfy its frozen unit and tolerance.
All measurements must have finite values and non-negative finite uncertainty.
Missing, stale, rejected or conflicted measurements cannot establish restoration.
Unknown or expired calibration cannot establish restoration.
Post-repair measurement uncertainty must not exceed the envelope-specific limit.
Post-repair verification measurement principle must be independent of the diagnostic measurement principles.
Post-repair verification dependency domain must be independent of the diagnostic dependency domains.
A targeted capability must have an independently observed pre-repair deficit.
The uncertainty interval must be wholly inside or wholly outside the acceptance envelope; boundary-overlapping results are not evaluable.
Every required non-target capability is checked for regression.
No single aggregate score may compensate for a non-target capability regression.
Concurrent changes must downgrade attribution to confounded; a before/after difference alone is not causal proof.
The evaluator always emits false for physical-restoration authorization, maintenance authorization and operating-restriction clearance.
Each measurement must bind observed_at and available_at, with observed_at no earlier than the episode start and available_at no later than episode end.
A Verified calibration state must reference a valid calibration-record SHA-256 digest.
Pre-repair and post-repair capability measurements must use the same independent reference measurement principle and dependency domain.
Both pre-repair baseline and post-repair verification paths must be independent of the diagnostic measurement principles and dependency domains.
The repair record must identify its intervention kind; only physical component repair can enter the physical restoration assessment.
Sensor replacement/calibration, controller/configuration changes, inspection-only, sham/no-op or unknown interventions cannot be reported as physical component restoration.
The case must bind a valid SHA-256 digest of the diagnosis revision that motivated the intervention; receipt-chain verification remains upstream.
The repair authorization reference must be bound to a valid authorization-record SHA-256 digest; this evaluator does not adjudicate authority.
Every capability measurement must bind a valid SHA-256 digest of its evidence bytes or evidence record.
A Verified calibration must bind a calibration-record digest and a validity-until time not earlier than measurement availability.
The acceptance-envelope set must be bound to a named owner reference and a digest matching the canonical capability-envelope set.
Both pre-repair baseline and post-repair verification must use the same measurement principle and dependency domain, both outside the diagnostic evidence path.
Every report must bind the exact serialized case content digest.

comparators.description: Accept a work-order/repair assertion as proof of restoration.
Treat cleared alarms or sensor-path correction as physical restoration.
Compare pre/post outcomes without matched operating conditions.
Check the repaired metric but ignore non-target capability regression.
Use the same diagnostic sensor/dependency path for post-repair verification.
Compare matched duty using independent calibrated measurements across every declared capability.

research_targets_not_achieved.target: 0 false restoration acceptances in the frozen synthetic fault/confounder corpus
0 physical restoration claims from sensor-path changes alone
100% of verified restoration claims include a calibrated independent measurement path
At least 95% correct capability dispositions on adequately sampled independent matched-duty cases
100% of restoration claims bind diagnosis revision, repair record, post-test evidence and envelope digests

claim_ceiling: The evaluator checks consistency of declared repair records, matched test conditions, measurement quality/independence and capability envelopes. It does not authenticate issuers, prove causal effects, establish durable safe life, authorize maintenance, clear operating restrictions or demonstrate physical restoration on a real engine. The diagnosis-revision digest is a lineage reference, not independent validation of its receipt chain. The acceptance-envelope owner reference and digest bind declared limits but do not establish OEM authority. Same-principle/dependency checks establish declared pathway diversity only, not statistical independence.
